seed: fail-closed credential key-scan pre-commit (fleet-hooks, wave 53)

Adds .githooks/pre-commit + setup.sh from SuperInstance/fleet-hooks
(byte-identical, commit bbc14cf). Makes the house practice — scanning staged
files for credential-shaped strings before every push (wave-52 receipts) —
self-enforcing at commit time.

Arm once with: sh setup.sh   (sets core.hooksPath .githooks, smoke-scans the
index, refuses to arm a hooks path with no hook behind it).

Scans staged INDEX blobs: ghp_/gho_/ghs_/ghu_ (36), github_pat_ (22+),
sk-ant prefix, AKIA+16. Fail-closed (scan errors block, exit 2), never echoes
matched content, FLEET_ALLOW=<ERE> line-granular escape hatch for obviously-
fake fixtures, no network, stdlib-only POSIX sh. 11/11 controls pass
(tests live in SuperInstance/fleet-hooks tests/test_hooks.sh).

commit.message:
playtest class 12 (welded): read-set state version in the effectful cache key

z's hold'em sheet found the freeze: callKey = caller + input cannot see
sheet state, so a repeated (caller, input) pair was served a stale
cached verdict after match.seq reset. Classes 7+10 fixed declared-dep
invalidation and distinct-input honesty, but not same-input-state-change:
a program reading a cell it did NOT declare as a dep kept serving its
first verdict forever.

Welded alternative per docs/Z_PATCH_RECONCILE.md (quilt-arcade): record
the cells a program actually reads through the bound runtime during
evaluation (patch-11 seam); bump per-cell state versions on every served
value change (set/push, effectful re-eval, formula recompute, stale
mark); a cache hit is only served while every read cell's version is
unchanged. Fresh when the read-set changed, cached when not — patch-12
correctness with main's cost profile (non-program effectful cells and
fan-out sheets pay nothing).

FAIL-first pin repeats the fish-reset freeze (3 tests): undeclared
match.seq reset must flip the verdict; unrelated sets must NOT bust the
cache; declared-dep upstream invalidation preserved. Pre-patch: pin 1
fails (stale OPEN served). Suite 66/66 green, tsc clean.
